Otherwise exact path.\n    const __m256 sign = _mm256_set1_ps(-0.0f);\n    const __m256 ax = _mm256_andnot_ps(sign, x);\n    const __m256 sat = _mm256_cmp_ps(ax, _mm256_mul_ps(t, _mm256_set1_ps(3.001f)), _CMP_GT_OQ);\n    const __m256 zero = _mm256_cmp_ps(x, _mm256_setzero_ps(), _CMP_EQ_OQ);\n    if (_mm256_movemask_ps(_mm256_or_ps(sat, zero)) == 0xFF) {\n        const __m256 one = _mm256_or_ps(_mm256_and_ps(x, sign), _mm256_set1_ps(1.0f));\n        const __m256 s = _mm256_blendv_ps(one, x, zero);\n        return _mm256_add_ps(_mm256_mul_ps(x, dry), _mm256_mul_ps(_mm256_mul_ps(s, t), wet));\n    }\n    const __m256 u = _mm256_div_ps(x, t);\n    const __m256 u2 = _mm256_mul_ps(u, u);\n    const __m256 num = _mm256_mul_ps(u, _mm256_add_ps(_mm256_set1_ps(27.0f), u2));\n    const __m256 den = _mm256_add_ps(_mm256_set1_ps(27.0f), _mm256_mul_ps(_mm256_set1_ps(9.0f), u2));\n    __m256 s = _mm256_div_ps(num, den);\n    s = _mm256_blendv_ps(s, _mm256_set1_ps(1.0f), _mm256_cmp_ps(u, _mm256_set1_ps(3.0f), _CMP_GT_OQ));\n    s = _mm256_blendv_ps(s, _mm256_set1_ps(-1.0f), _mm256_cmp_ps(u, _mm256_set1_ps(-3.0f), _CMP_LT_OQ));\n    return _mm256_add_ps(_mm256_mul_ps(x, dry), _mm256_mul_ps(_mm256_mul_ps(s, t), wet));\n}\n\nCEDAR_TARGET_AVX2\ninline void soft_avx2(const float* in_l, const float* in_r, const float* threshold,\n                      const float* dry_level, const float* wet_level,\n                      float* out_l, float* out_r) noexcept {\n    const __m256 lo = _mm256_set1_ps(0.1f);\n    const __m256 hi = _mm256_set1_ps(2.0f);\n    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < BLOCK_SIZE; i += 8) {\n        // std::clamp: (t < lo) ? lo : (hi < t) ? hi : t. max/min return the 2nd operand\n        // when either is NaN, so NaN passes through like the scalar (lo, hi are > 0).\n        const __m256 t = _mm256_min_ps(hi, _mm256_max_ps(lo, _mm256_load_ps(threshold + i)));\n        const __m256 dry = coeff8(dry_level, i, 0.0f);\n        const __m256 wet = coeff8(wet_level, i, 1.0f);\n        const __m256 xl = _mm256_load_ps(in_l + i);\n        const __m256 yl = soft8(xl, t, dry, wet);\n        _mm256_store_ps(out_l + i, yl);\n        if (in_r) {\n            _mm256_store_ps(out_r + i, soft8(_mm256_load_ps(in_r + i), t, dry, wet));\n        } else {\n            _mm256_store_ps(out_r + i, yl);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n#endif\n}  // namespace distort_kernels\n\n// ============================================================================\n// DISTORT_TANH: Tanh Saturation\n// ============================================================================\n// in0: input signal\n// in1: drive (1.0 = unity, higher = more saturation)\n//\n// Classic warm saturation using hyperbolic tangent.\n// Higher drive values push the signal into saturation more aggressively.\n\n[[gnu::always_inline]]\ninline void op_distort_tanh(ExecutionContext& ctx, const Instruction& inst) {","numLines":150,"startLine":1,"totalLines":716}}}

Takes w = 2z*log2(e); tanh(z) = 1 - 2 / (e + 1),\n// e = 2^w, w clamped to [-28, 28] so e stays finite (tanh(9.7) == 1 to 4e-9).\n// 2^w = 2^n * poly4(f), f = w - n in [-1/2, 1/2] (no ln2 multiply); relative error ~5e-6\n// (tanh err ~2.5e-6).\nCEDAR_TARGET_AVX2 [[gnu::always_inline]]\ninline __m256 tanh8(__m256 w) noexcept {\n    // All |z| < 0.0097: tanh(z) = z - z^3/3, error < 4e-7, so return z = w/(2 log2 e) and\n    // skip the exp polynomial and divide (silent/quiet blocks). NaN -> slow path.\n    if (_mm256_movemask_ps(_mm256_cmp_ps(_mm256_andnot_ps(_mm256_set1_ps(-0.0f), w),\n                                         _mm256_set1_ps(0.028f), _CMP_LT_OQ)) == 0xFF)\n        return _mm256_mul_ps(w, _mm256_set1_ps(0.34657359f));\n    w = _mm256_min_ps(_mm256_set1_ps(28.0f), w);  // NaN in w propagates (2nd operand)\n    w = _mm256_max_ps(_mm256_set1_ps(-28.0f), w);\n    const __m256i n = _mm256_cvtps_epi32(w);\n    const __m256 r = _mm256_sub_ps(w, _mm256_cvtepi32_ps(n));\n    // 2^f = sum (ln2 f)^k / k!, degree-5 term Chebyshev-economised onto f, f^3 (a = 1/2):\n    // f^5 ~ 1.25 a^2 f^3 - 0.3125 a^4 f; omitted f^6 term is ~2.4e-6.\n    __m256 p = _mm256_set1_ps(0.0096181291f);\n    p = _mm256_add_ps(_mm256_mul_ps(p, r), _mm256_set1_ps(0.055920783f));\n    p = _mm256_add_ps(_mm256_mul_ps(p, r), _mm256_set1_ps(0.240226507f));\n    p = _mm256_add_ps(_mm256_mul_ps(p, r), _mm256_set1_ps(0.6931211385f));\n    p = _mm256_add_ps(_mm256_mul_ps(p, r), _mm256_set1_ps(1.0f));\n    // p in [0.7, 1.42] is normal: adding n to its exponent field scales by 2^n.\n    const __m256 e = _mm256_castsi256_ps(\n        _mm256_add_epi32(_mm256_castps_si256(p), _mm256_slli_epi32(n, 23)));\n    return _mm256_sub_ps(_mm256_set1_ps(1.0f),\n                         _mm256_div_ps(_mm256_set1_ps(2.0f), _mm256_add_ps(e, _mm256_set1_ps(1.0f))));\n}\n\nCEDAR_TARGET_AVX2\ninline void tanh_avx2(const float* in_l, const float* in_r, const float* drive,\n                      const float* dry_level, const float* wet_level,\n                      float* out_l, float* out_r) noexcept {\n    const __m256 dmin = _mm256_set1_ps(0.1f);\n    const __m256 k = _mm256_set1_ps(2.88539008f);  // 2 * log2(e)\n    if (!dry_level && !wet_level) {\n        // Default dry=0, wet=1: x*0 + y*1 == y for finite x, so skip the mix.\n        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < BLOCK_SIZE; i += 8) {\n            const __m256 d = _mm256_max_ps(_mm256_load_ps(drive + i), dmin);\n            const __m256 d2 = _mm256_mul_ps(d, k);\n            const __m256 yl = tanh8(_mm256_mul_ps(_mm256_load_ps(in_l + i), d2));\n            _mm256_store_ps(out_l + i, yl);\n            _mm256_store_ps(out_r + i, in_r ? tanh8(_mm256_mul_ps(_mm256_load_ps(in_r + i), d2)) : yl);\n        }\n        return;\n    }\n    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < BLOCK_SIZE; i += 8) {\n        const __m256 d = _mm256_max_ps(_mm256_load_ps(drive + i), dmin);  // == (0.1f < d) ? d : 0.1f\n        const __m256 d2 = _mm256_mul_ps(d, k);  // tanh8 takes w = x*d*2*log2(e)\n        const __m256 dry = coeff8(dry_level, i, 0.0f);\n        const __m256 wet = coeff8(wet_level, i, 1.0f);\n        const __m256 xl = _mm256_load_ps(in_l + i);\n        const __m256 yl = _mm256_add_ps(_mm256_mul_ps(xl, dry),\n                                        _mm256_mul_ps(tanh8(_mm256_mul_ps(xl, d2)), wet));\n        _mm256_store_ps(out_l + i, yl);\n        if (in_r) {\n            const __m256 xr = _mm256_load_ps(in_r + i);\n            _mm256_store_ps(out_r + i, _mm256_add_ps(_mm256_mul_ps(xr, dry),\n                                        _mm256_mul_ps(tanh8(_mm256_mul_ps(xr, d2)), wet)));\n        } else {\n            _mm256_store_ps(out_r + i, yl);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Bit-identical to the scalar soft(x / t) * t mix.\nCEDAR_TARGET_AVX2 [[gnu::always_inline]]\ninline __m256 soft8(__m256 x, __m256 t, __m256 dry, __m256 wet) noexcept {\n    // Divide-free path (vdivps throughput bounds this kernel) when every lane is\n    // exactly zero (soft(+-0) = +-0, so s = x keeps the sign) or surely saturated\n    // (|x| > 3.001 t  =>  |x/t| > 3 despite rounding, s = +-1). Otherwise exact path.\n    const __m256 sign = _mm256_set1_ps(-0.0f);\n    const __m256 ax = _mm256_andnot_ps(sign, x);\n    const __m256 sat = _mm256_cmp_ps(ax, _mm256_mul_ps(t, _mm256_set1_ps(3.001f)), _CMP_GT_OQ);\n    const __m256 zero = _mm256_cmp_ps(x, _mm256_setzero_ps(), _CMP_EQ_OQ);\n    if (_mm256_movemask_ps(_mm256_or_ps(sat, zero)) == 0xFF) {\n        const __m256 one = _mm256_or_ps(_mm256_and_ps(x, sign), _mm256_set1_ps(1.0f));\n        const __m256 s = _mm256_blendv_ps(one, x, zero);\n        return _mm256_add_ps(_mm256_mul_ps(x, dry), _mm256_mul_ps(_mm256_mul_ps(s, t), wet));\n    }\n    const __m256 u = _mm256_div_ps(x, t);\n    const __m256 u2 = _mm256_mul_ps(u, u);\n    const __m256 num = _mm256_mul_ps(u, _mm256_add_ps(_mm256_set1_ps(27.0f), u2));\n    const __m256 den = _mm256_add_ps(_mm256_set1_ps(27.0f), _mm256_mul_ps(_mm256_set1_ps(9.0f), u2));\n    __m256 s = _mm256_div_ps(num, den);\n    s = _mm256_blendv_ps(s, _mm256_set1_ps(1.0f), _mm256_cmp_ps(u, _mm256_set1_ps(3.0f), _CMP_GT_OQ));\n    s = _mm256_blendv_ps(s, _mm256_set1_ps(-1.0f), _mm256_cmp_ps(u, _mm256_set1_ps(-3.0f), _CMP_LT_OQ));\n    return _mm256_add_ps(_mm256_mul_ps(x, dry), _mm256_mul_ps(_mm256_mul_ps(s, t), wet));\n}\n\nCEDAR_TARGET_AVX2\ninline void soft_avx2(const float* in_l, const float* in_r, const float* threshold,\n                      const float* dry_level, const float* wet_level,\n                      float* out_l, float* out_r) noexcept {\n    const __m256 lo = _mm256_set1_ps(0.1f);\n    const __m256 hi = _mm256_set1_ps(2.0f);\n    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < BLOCK_SIZE; i += 8) {\n        // std::clamp: (t < lo) ? lo : (hi < t) ? hi : t. max/min return the 2nd operand\n        // when either is NaN, so NaN passes through like the scalar (lo, hi are > 0).\n        const __m256 t = _mm256_min_ps(hi, _mm256_max_ps(lo, _mm256_load_ps(threshold + i)));\n        const __m256 dry = coeff8(dry_level, i, 0.0f);\n        const __m256 wet = coeff8(wet_level, i, 1.0f);\n        const __m256 xl = _mm256_load_ps(in_l + i);\n        const __m256 yl = soft8(xl, t, dry, wet);\n        _mm256_store_ps(out_l + i, yl);\n        if (in_r) {\n            _mm256_store_ps(out_r + i, soft8(_mm256_load_ps(in_r + i), t, dry, wet));\n        } else {\n            _mm256_store_ps(out_r + i, yl);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n#endif\n}  // namespace distort_kernels\n\n// ============================================================================\n// DISTORT_TANH: Tanh Saturation\n// ============================================================================\n// in0: input signal\n// in1: drive (1.0 = unity, higher = more saturation)\n//\n// Classic warm saturation using hyperbolic tangent.\n// Higher drive values push the signal into saturation more aggressively.\n\n[[gnu::always_inline]]\ninline void op_distort_tanh(ExecutionContext& ctx, const Instruction& inst) {\n    float* out_l = ctx.buffers->get(inst.out_buffer);\n    float* out_r = ctx.buffers->get(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(inst.out_buffer + 1));\n    const float* input = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[0]);\n    const bool stereo_in = (inst.flags & InstructionFlag::STEREO_INPUT) != 0;\n    const float* input_r = stereo_in\n        ? ctx.buffers->get(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(inst.inputs[0] + 1))\n        : nullptr;\n    const float* drive = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[1]);\n    const float* dry_level = (inst.inputs[2] != 0xFFFF) ? ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[2]) : nullptr;\n    const float* wet_level = (inst.inputs[3] != 0xFFFF) ? ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[3]) : nullptr;\n\n#if CEDAR_SIMD_X86\n    if (simd::has(simd::Isa::Avx2)) {\n        distort_kernels::tanh_avx2(input, input_r, drive, dry_level, wet_level, out_l, out_r);\n        return;\n    }\n#endif\n    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < BLOCK_SIZE; ++i) {\n        float d = std::max(0.1f, drive[i]);\n        float dry = drywet::coeff(dry_level, i, 0.0f);\n        float wet = drywet::coeff(wet_level, i, 1.0f);\n        float x_l = input[i];\n        float x_r = stereo_in ? input_r[i] : x_l;\n        out_l[i] = drywet::mix(x_l, std::tanh(x_l * d), dry, wet);\n        out_r[i] = drywet::mix(x_r, std::tanh(x_r * d), dry, wet);\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// DISTORT_SOFT: Polynomial Soft Clipping\n// ============================================================================\n// in0: input signal\n// in1: threshold (0.1-2.0, lower = more clipping)\n//\n// Smooth polynomial soft clipper that rounds off peaks gradually.\n// Uses cubic polynomial for continuous first derivative.\n\n[[gnu::always_inline]]\ninline void op_distort_soft(ExecutionContext& ctx, const Instruction& inst) {\n    float* out_l = ctx.buffers->get(inst.out_buffer);\n    float* out_r = ctx.buffers->get(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(inst.out_buffer + 1));\n    const float* input = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[0]);\n    const bool stereo_in = (inst.flags & InstructionFlag::STEREO_INPUT) != 0;\n    const float* input_r = stereo_in\n        ? ctx.buffers->get(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(inst.inputs[0] + 1))\n        : nullptr;\n    const float* threshold = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[1]);\n    const float* dry_level = (inst.inputs[2] != 0xFFFF) ? ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[2]) : nullptr;\n    const float* wet_level = (inst.inputs[3] != 0xFFFF) ? ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[3]) : nullptr;\n\n    auto soft = [](float x) {\n        if (x > 3.0f) return 1.0f;\n        if (x < -3.0f) return -1.0f;\n        float x2 = x * x;\n        return x * (27.0f + x2) / (27.0f + 9.0f * x2);\n    };\n\n#if CEDAR_SIMD_X86\n    if (simd::has(simd::Isa::Avx2)) {\n        distort_kernels::soft_avx2(input, input_r, threshold, dry_level, wet_level, out_l, out_r);\n        return;\n    }\n#endif\n    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < BLOCK_SIZE; ++i) {\n        float t = std::clamp(threshold[i], 0.1f, 2.0f);\n        float dry = drywet::coeff(dry_level, i, 0.0f);\n        float wet = drywet::coeff(wet_level, i, 1.0f);\n        float x_l = input[i];\n        float x_r = stereo_in ? input_r[i] : x_l;\n        out_l[i] = drywet::mix(x_l, soft(x_l / t) * t, dry, wet);\n        out_r[i] = drywet::mix(x_r, soft(x_r / t) * t, dry, wet);\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// DISTORT_BITCRUSH: Bit Crusher / Sample Rate Reducer\n// ============================================================================\n// in0: input signal\n// in1: bit depth (1-16, fractional allowed for smooth transitions)\n// in2: sample rate reduction factor (0.0-1.0, where 1.0 = full rate, 0.1 = 1/10th rate)\n//\n// Lo-fi effect that reduces bit depth and/or sample rate.\n// Creates classic 8-bit and retro digital sounds.\n\n[[gnu::always_inline]]\ninline void op_distort_bitcrush(ExecutionContext& ctx, const Instruction& inst) {\n    float* out_l = ctx.buffers->get(inst.out_buffer);\n    float* out_r = ctx.buffers->get(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(inst.out_buffer + 1));\n    const float* input = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[0]);\n    const bool stereo_in = (inst.flags & InstructionFlag::STEREO_INPUT) != 0;\n    const float* input_r = stereo_in\n        ? ctx.buffers->get(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(inst.inputs[0] + 1))\n        : nullptr;\n    const float* bits = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[1]);\n    const float* rate = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[2]);\n    const float* dry_level = (inst.inputs[3] != 0xFFFF) ? ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[3]) : nullptr;\n    const float* wet_level = (inst.inputs[4] != 0xFFFF) ? ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[4]) : nullptr;\n    auto& state = ctx.states->get_or_create<BitcrushState>(inst.state_id);\n\n    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < BLOCK_SIZE; ++i) {\n        // Mono control inputs (shared across channels)\n        float rate_factor = std::clamp(rate[i], 0.01f, 1.0f);\n        float depth = std::clamp(bits[i], 1.0f, 16.0f);\n        float levels = std::pow(2.0f, depth);\n        float dry = drywet::coeff(dry_level, i, 0.0f);\n        float wet = drywet::coeff(wet_level, i, 1.0f);\n\n        for (std::size_t ch = 0; ch < 2; ++ch) {\n            float x = (ch == 0) ? input[i] : (stereo_in ? input_r[i] : input[i]);\n            state.phase[ch] += rate_factor;\n            if (state.phase[ch] >= 1.0f) {\n                state.phase[ch] -= 1.0f;\n                state.held_sample[ch] = std::round(x * levels) / levels;\n            }\n            (ch == 0 ? out_l : out_r)[i] = drywet::mix(x, state.held_sample[ch], dry, wet);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// DISTORT_FOLD: Wavefolder with ADAA (Antiderivative Antialiasing)\n// ============================================================================\n// in0: input signal\n// in1: drive (1.0-10.0, fold intensity)\n// in2: symmetry (0.0-1.0, 0.5 = symmetric, other = asymmetric harmonics)\n//\n// Alias-free sine wavefolder using first-order ADAA.\n// Classic West Coast synthesis technique with mathematical anti-aliasing.\n// f(x) = sin(drive * x)\n// F₁(x) = -cos(drive * x) / drive  (antiderivative)\n// ADAA: y[n] = (F₁(x[n]) - F₁(x[n-1])) / (x[n] - x[n-1])\n\n[[gnu::always_inline]]\ninline void op_distort_fold(ExecutionContext& ctx, const Instruction& inst) {\n    float* out_l = ctx.buffers->get(inst.out_buffer);\n    float* out_r = ctx.buffers->get(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(inst.out_buffer + 1));\n    const float* input = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[0]);\n    const bool stereo_in = (inst.flags & InstructionFlag::STEREO_INPUT) != 0;\n    const float* input_r = stereo_in\n        ? Takes w = 2z*log2(e); tanh(z) = 1 - 2 / (e + 1),\n// e = 2^w, w clamped to [-28, 28] so e stays finite (tanh(9.7) == 1 to 4e-9).\n// 2^w = 2^n * poly4(f), f = w - n in [-1/2, 1/2] (no ln2 multiply); relative error ~5e-6\n// (tanh err ~2.5e-6).\nCEDAR_TARGET_AVX2 [[gnu::always_inline]]\ninline __m256 tanh8_exp(__m256 w) noexcept {\n    w = _mm256_min_ps(_mm256_set1_ps(28.0f), w); omitted f^6 term is ~2.4e-6.\n    __m256 p = _mm256_set1_ps(0.0096181291f);\n    p = _mm256_add_ps(_mm256_mul_ps(p, r), _mm256_set1_ps(0.055920783f));\n    p = _mm256_add_ps(_mm256_mul_ps(p, r), _mm256_set1_ps(0.240226507f));\n    p = _mm256_add_ps(_mm256_mul_ps(p, r), _mm256_set1_ps(0.6931211385f));\n    p = _mm256_add_ps(_mm256_mul_ps(p, r), _mm256_set1_ps(1.0f));\n    // p in [0.7, 1.42] is normal: adding n to its exponent field scales by 2^n.\n    const __m256 e = _mm256_castsi256_ps(\n        _mm256_add_epi32(_mm256_castps_si256(p), _mm256_slli_epi32(n, 23)));\n    return _mm256_sub_ps(_mm256_set1_ps(1.0f),\n                         _mm256_div_ps(_mm256_set1_ps(2.0f), _mm256_add_ps(e, _mm256_set1_ps(1.0f))));\n}\n\nCEDAR_TARGET_AVX2\ninline void tanh_avx2(const float* in_l, const float* in_r, const float* drive,\n                      const float* dry_level, const float* wet_level,\n                      float* out_l, float* out_r) noexcept {\n    const __m256 dmin = _mm256_set1_ps(0.1f);\n    const __m256 k = _mm256_set1_ps(2.88539008f); i < BLOCK_SIZE; i += 8) {\n        const __m256 d = _mm256_max_ps(_mm256_load_ps(drive + i), dmin);  // == (0.1f < d) ? d : 0.1f\n        const __m256 d2 = _mm256_mul_ps(d, k);  // tanh8 takes w = x*d*2*log2(e)\n        const __m256 dry = coeff8(dry_level, i, 0.0f);\n        const __m256 wet = coeff8(wet_level, i, 1.0f);\n        const __m256 xl = _mm256_load_ps(in_l + i);\n        const __m256 yl = _mm256_add_ps(_mm256_mul_ps(xl, dry),\n                                        _mm256_mul_ps(tanh8(_mm256_mul_ps(xl, d2)), wet));\n        _mm256_store_ps(out_l + i, yl);\n        if (in_r) {\n            const __m256 xr = _mm256_load_ps(in_r + i);\n            _mm256_store_ps(out_r + i, _mm256_add_ps(_mm256_mul_ps(xr, dry),\n                                        _mm256_mul_ps(tanh8(_mm256_mul_ps(xr, d2)), wet)));\n        } else {\n            _mm256_store_ps(out_r + i, yl);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Bit-identical to the scalar soft(x / t) * t mix.\nCEDAR_TARGET_AVX2 [[gnu::always_inline]]\ninline __m256 soft8(__m256 x, __m256 t, __m256 dry, __m256 wet) noexcept {\n    // Divide-free path (vdivps throughput bounds this kernel) when every lane is\n    // exactly zero (soft(+-0) = +-0, so s = x keeps the sign) or surely saturated\n    // (|x| > 3.001 t  =>  |x/t| > 3 despite rounding, s = +-1). Otherwise exact path.\n    const __m256 sign = _mm256_set1_ps(-0.0f);\n    const __m256 ax = _mm256_andnot_ps(sign, x);\n    const __m256 sat = _mm256_cmp_ps(ax, _mm256_mul_ps(t, _mm256_set1_ps(3.001f)), _CMP_GT_OQ);\n    const __m256 zero = _mm256_cmp_ps(x, _mm256_setzero_ps(), _CMP_EQ_OQ);\n    if (_mm256_movemask_ps(_mm256_or_ps(sat, zero)) == 0xFF) {\n        const __m256 one = _mm256_or_ps(_mm256_and_ps(x, sign), _mm256_set1_ps(1.0f));\n        const __m256 s = _mm256_blendv_ps(one, x, zero);\n        return _mm256_add_ps(_mm256_mul_ps(x, dry), _mm256_mul_ps(_mm256_mul_ps(s, t), wet));\n    }\n    const __m256 u = _mm256_div_ps(x, t);\n    const __m256 u2 = _mm256_mul_ps(u, u);\n    const __m256 num = _mm256_mul_ps(u, _mm256_add_ps(_mm256_set1_ps(27.0f), u2));\n    const __m256 den = _mm256_add_ps(_mm256_set1_ps(27.0f), _mm256_mul_ps(_mm256_set1_ps(9.0f), u2));\n    __m256 s = _mm256_div_ps(num, den);\n    s = _mm256_blendv_ps(s, _mm256_set1_ps(1.0f), _mm256_cmp_ps(u, _mm256_set1_ps(3.0f), _CMP_GT_OQ));\n    s = _mm256_blendv_ps(s, _mm256_set1_ps(-1.0f), _mm256_cmp_ps(u, _mm256_set1_ps(-3.0f), _CMP_LT_OQ));\n    return _mm256_add_ps(_mm256_mul_ps(x, dry), _mm256_mul_ps(_mm256_mul_ps(s, t), wet));\n}\n\nCEDAR_TARGET_AVX2\ninline void soft_avx2(const float* in_l, const float* in_r, const float* threshold,\n                      const float* dry_level, const float* wet_level,\n                      float* out_l, float* out_r) noexcept {\n    const __m256 lo = _mm256_set1_ps(0.1f);\n    const __m256 hi = _mm256_set1_ps(2.0f);\n    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < BLOCK_SIZE; i += 8) {\n        // std::clamp: (t < lo) ? lo : (hi < t) ? hi : t. max/min return the 2nd operand\n        // when either is NaN, so NaN passes through like the scalar (lo, hi are > 0).\n        const __m256 t = _mm256_min_ps(hi, _mm256_max_ps(lo, _mm256_load_ps(threshold + i)));\n        const __m256 dry = coeff8(dry_level, i, 0.0f);\n        const __m256 wet = coeff8(wet_level, i, 1.0f);\n        const __m256 xl = _mm256_load_ps(in_l + i);\n        const __m256 yl = soft8(xl, t, dry, wet);\n        _mm256_store_ps(out_l + i, yl);\n        if (in_r) {\n            _mm256_store_ps(out_r + i, soft8(_mm256_load_ps(in_r + i), t, dry, wet));\n        } else {\n            _mm256_store_ps(out_r + i, yl);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n#endif\n}  // namespace distort_kernels\n\n// ============================================================================\n// DISTORT_TANH: Tanh Saturation\n// ============================================================================\n// in0: input signal\n// in1: drive (1.0 = unity, higher = more saturation)\n//\n// Classic warm saturation using hyperbolic tangent.\n// Higher drive values push the signal into saturation more aggressively.\n\n[[gnu::always_inline]]\ninline void op_distort_tanh(ExecutionContext& ctx, const Instruction& inst) {\n    float* out_l = ctx.buffers->get(inst.out_buffer);\n    float* out_r = ctx.buffers->get(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(inst.out_buffer + 1));\n    const float* input = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[0]);\n    const bool stereo_in = (inst.flags & InstructionFlag::STEREO_INPUT) != 0;\n    const float* input_r = stereo_in\n        ? ctx.buffers->get(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(inst.inputs[0] + 1))\n        : nullptr;\n    const float* drive = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[1]);\n    const float* dry_level = (inst.inputs[2] != 0xFFFF) ? ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[2]) : nullptr;\n    const float* wet_level = (inst.inputs[3] != 0xFFFF) ? ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[3]) : nullptr;\n\n#if CEDAR_SIMD_X86\n    if (simd::has(simd::Isa::Avx2)) {\n        distort_kernels::tanh_avx2(input, input_r, drive, dry_level, wet_level, out_l, out_r);\n        return;\n    }\n#endif\n    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < BLOCK_SIZE; ++i) {\n        float d = std::max(0.1f, drive[i]);\n        float dry = drywet::coeff(dry_level, i, 0.0f);\n        float wet = drywet::coeff(wet_level, i, 1.0f);\n        float x_l = input[i];\n        float x_r = stereo_in ? input_r[i] : x_l;\n        out_l[i] = drywet::mix(x_l, std::tanh(x_l * d), dry, wet);\n        out_r[i] = drywet::mix(x_r, std::tanh(x_r * d), dry, wet);\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// DISTORT_SOFT: Polynomial Soft Clipping\n// ============================================================================\n// in0: input signal\n// in1: threshold (0.1-2.0, lower = more clipping)\n//\n// Smooth polynomial soft clipper that rounds off peaks gradually.\n// Uses cubic polynomial for continuous first derivative.\n\n[[gnu::always_inline]]\ninline void op_distort_soft(ExecutionContext& ctx, const Instruction& inst) {\n    float* out_l = ctx.buffers->get(inst.out_buffer);\n    float* out_r = ctx.buffers->get(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(inst.out_buffer + 1));\n    const float* input = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[0]);\n    const bool stereo_in = (inst.flags & InstructionFlag::STEREO_INPUT) != 0;\n    const float* input_r = stereo_in\n        ? ctx.buffers->get(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(inst.inputs[0] + 1))\n        : nullptr;\n    const float* threshold = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[1]);\n    const float* dry_level = (inst.inputs[2] != 0xFFFF) ? ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[2]) : nullptr;\n    const float* wet_level = (inst.inputs[3] != 0xFFFF) ? ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[3]) : nullptr;\n\n    auto soft = [](float x) {\n        if (x > 3.0f) return 1.0f;\n        if (x < -3.0f) return -1.0f;\n        float x2 = x * x;\n        return x * (27.0f + x2) / (27.0f + 9.0f * x2);\n    };\n\n#if CEDAR_SIMD_X86\n    if (simd::has(simd::Isa::Avx2)) {\n        distort_kernels::soft_avx2(input, input_r, threshold, dry_level, wet_level, out_l, out_r);\n        return;\n    }\n#endif\n    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < BLOCK_SIZE; ++i) {\n        float t = std::clamp(threshold[i], 0.1f, 2.0f);\n        float dry = drywet::coeff(dry_level, i, 0.0f);\n        float wet = drywet::coeff(wet_level, i, 1.0f);\n        float x_l = input[i];\n        float x_r = stereo_in ? input_r[i] : x_l;\n        out_l[i] = drywet::mix(x_l, soft(x_l / t) * t, dry, wet);\n        out_r[i] = drywet::mix(x_r, soft(x_r / t) * t, dry, wet);\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// DISTORT_BITCRUSH: Bit Crusher / Sample Rate Reducer\n// ============================================================================\n// in0: input signal\n// in1: bit depth (1-16, fractional allowed for smooth transitions)\n// in2: sample rate reduction factor (0.0-1.0, where 1.0 = full rate, 0.1 = 1/10th rate)\n//\n// Lo-fi effect that reduces bit depth and/or sample rate.\n// Creates classic 8-bit and retro digital sounds.\n\n[[gnu::always_inline]]\ninline void op_distort_bitcrush(ExecutionContext& ctx, const Instruction& inst) {\n    float* out_l = ctx.buffers->get(inst.out_buffer);\n    float* out_r = ctx.buffers->get(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(inst.out_buffer + 1));\n    const float* input = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[0]);\n    const bool stereo_in = (inst.flags & InstructionFlag::STEREO_INPUT) != 0;\n    const float* input_r = stereo_in\n        ? ctx.buffers->get(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(inst.inputs[0] + 1))\n        : nullptr;\n    const float* bits = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[1]);\n    const float* rate = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[2]);\n    const float* dry_level = (inst.inputs[3] != 0xFFFF) ? Takes w = 2z*log2(e); tanh(z) = 1 - 2 / (e + 1),\n// e = 2^w, w clamped to [-28, 28] so e stays finite (tanh(9.7) == 1 to 4e-9).\n// 2^w = 2^n * poly4(f), f = w - n in [-1/2, 1/2] (no ln2 multiply); relative error ~5e-6\n// (tanh err ~2.5e-6).\nCEDAR_TARGET_AVX2 [[gnu::always_inline]]\ninline __m256 tanh8_exp(__m256 w) noexcept {\n    w = _mm256_min_ps(_mm256_set1_ps(28.0f), w);  // NaN in w propagates (2nd operand)\n    w = _mm256_max_ps(_mm256_set1_ps(-28.0f), w);\n    const __m256i n = _mm256_cvtps_epi32(w);\n    const __m256 r = _mm256_sub_ps(w, _mm256_cvtepi32_ps(n));\n    // 2^f = sum (ln2 f)^k / k!, degree-5 term Chebyshev-economised onto f, f^3 (a = 1/2):\n    // f^5 ~ 1.25 a^2 f^3 - 0.3125 a^4 f; omitted f^6 term is ~2.4e-6.\n    __m256 p = _mm256_set1_ps(0.0096181291f);\n    p = _mm256_add_ps(_mm256_mul_ps(p, r), _mm256_set1_ps(0.055920783f));\n    p = _mm256_add_ps(_mm256_mul_ps(p, r), _mm256_set1_ps(0.240226507f));\n    p = _mm256_add_ps(_mm256_mul_ps(p, r), _mm256_set1_ps(0.6931211385f));\n    p = _mm256_add_ps(_mm256_mul_ps(p, r), _mm256_set1_ps(1.0f));\n    // p in [0.7, 1.42] is normal: adding n to its exponent field scales by 2^n.\n    const __m256 e = _mm256_castsi256_ps(\n        _mm256_add_epi32(_mm256_castps_si256(p), _mm256_slli_epi32(n, 23)));\n    return _mm256_sub_ps(_mm256_set1_ps(1.0f),\n                         _mm256_div_ps(_mm256_set1_ps(2.0f), _mm256_add_ps(e, _mm256_set1_ps(1.0f))));\n}\n\n// All |z| < 0.0097: tanh(z) = z - z^3/3, error < 4e-7, so return z = w/(2 log2 e) and\n// skip the exp polynomial and divide (silent/quiet blocks). NaN -> slow path.\nCEDAR_TARGET_AVX2 [[gnu::always_inline]]\ninline __m256 tanh8(__m256 w) noexcept {\n    if (_mm256_movemask_ps(_mm256_cmp_ps(_mm256_andnot_ps(_mm256_set1_ps(-0.0f), w),\n                                         _mm256_set1_ps(0.028f), _CMP_LT_OQ)) == 0xFF)\n        return _mm256_mul_ps(w, _mm256_set1_ps(0.34657359f));\n    return tanh8_exp(w);\n}\n\n// Two vectors under one quiet-block check (fewer uops per vector on loud signals).\nCEDAR_TARGET_AVX2 [[gnu::always_inline]]\ninline void tanh8x2(__m256 w0, __m256 w1, __m256& y0, __m256& y1) noexcept {\n    const __m256 sign = _mm256_set1_ps(-0.0f);\n    const __m256 m = _mm256_max_ps(_mm256_andnot_ps(sign, w0), _mm256_andnot_ps(sign, w1));\n    // max_ps returns the 2nd operand on NaN; a NaN in w0 or w1 can only fail the compare\n    // or be absorbed into the other operand, and the OQ compare below is false for NaN.\n    // A NaN in w0 is lost only if w1 is not NaN, so also compare each vector's own NaN.\n    const __m256 nan = _mm256_cmp_ps(_mm256_add_ps(w0, w1), _mm256_add_ps(w0, w1), _CMP_UNORD_Q);\n    if ((_mm256_movemask_ps(_mm256_cmp_ps(m, _mm256_set1_ps(0.028f), _CMP_LT_OQ)) &\n         ~_mm256_movemask_ps(nan) & 0xFF) == 0xFF) {\n        const __m256 c = _mm256_set1_ps(0.34657359f);\n        y0 = _mm256_mul_ps(w0, c);\n        y1 = _mm256_mul_ps(w1, c);\n        return;\n    }\n    y0 = tanh8_exp(w0);\n    y1 = tanh8_exp(w1);\n}\n\nCEDAR_TARGET_AVX2\ninline void tanh_avx2(const float* in_l, const float* in_r, const float* drive,\n                      const float* dry_level, const float* wet_level,\n                      float* out_l, float* out_r) noexcept {\n    const __m256 dmin = _mm256_set1_ps(0.1f);\n    const __m256 k = _mm256_set1_ps(2.88539008f);  // 2 * log2(e)\n    if (!dry_level && !wet_level) {\n        // Default dry=0, wet=1: x*0 + y*1 == y for finite x, so skip the mix.\n        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < BLOCK_SIZE; i += 8) {\n            const __m256 d = _mm256_max_ps(_mm256_load_ps(drive + i), dmin);\n            const __m256 d2 = _mm256_mul_ps(d, k);\n            const __m256 yl = tanh8(_mm256_mul_ps(_mm256_load_ps(in_l + i), d2));\n            _mm256_store_ps(out_l + i, yl);\n            _mm256_store_ps(out_r + i, in_r ? tanh8(_mm256_mul_ps(_mm256_load_ps(in_r + i), d2)) : yl);\n        }\n        return;\n    }\n    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < BLOCK_SIZE; i += 8) {\n        const __m256 d = _mm256_max_ps(_mm256_load_ps(drive + i), dmin);  // == (0.1f < d) ? d : 0.1f\n        const __m256 d2 = _mm256_mul_ps(d, k);  // tanh8 takes w = x*d*2*log2(e)\n        const __m256 dry = coeff8(dry_level, i, 0.0f);\n        const __m256 wet = coeff8(wet_level, i, 1.0f);\n        const __m256 xl = _mm256_load_ps(in_l + i);\n        const __m256 yl = _mm256_add_ps(_mm256_mul_ps(xl, dry),\n                                        _mm256_mul_ps(tanh8(_mm256_mul_ps(xl, d2)), wet));\n        _mm256_store_ps(out_l + i, yl);\n        if (in_r) {\n            const __m256 xr = _mm256_load_ps(in_r + i);\n            _mm256_store_ps(out_r + i, _mm256_add_ps(_mm256_mul_ps(xr, dry),\n                                        _mm256_mul_ps(tanh8(_mm256_mul_ps(xr, d2)), wet)));\n        } else {\n            _mm256_store_ps(out_r + i, yl);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Bit-identical to the scalar soft(x / t) * t mix.\nCEDAR_TARGET_AVX2 [[gnu::always_inline]]\ninline __m256 soft8(__m256 x, __m256 t, __m256 dry, __m256 wet) noexcept {\n    // Divide-free path (vdivps throughput bounds this kernel) when every lane is\n    // exactly zero (soft(+-0) = +-0, so s = x keeps the sign) or surely saturated\n    // (|x| > 3.001 t  =>  |x/t| > 3 despite rounding, s = +-1). Otherwise exact path.\n    const __m256 sign = _mm256_set1_ps(-0.0f);\n    const __m256 ax = _mm256_andnot_ps(sign, x);\n    const __m256 sat = _mm256_cmp_ps(ax, _mm256_mul_ps(t, _mm256_set1_ps(3.001f)), _CMP_GT_OQ);\n    const __m256 zero = _mm256_cmp_ps(x, _mm256_setzero_ps(), _CMP_EQ_OQ);\n    if (_mm256_movemask_ps(_mm256_or_ps(sat, zero)) == 0xFF) {\n        const __m256 one = _mm256_or_ps(_mm256_and_ps(x, sign), _mm256_set1_ps(1.0f));\n        const __m256 s = _mm256_blendv_ps(one, x, zero);\n        return _mm256_add_ps(_mm256_mul_ps(x, dry), _mm256_mul_ps(_mm256_mul_ps(s, t), wet));\n    }\n    const __m256 u = _mm256_div_ps(x, t);\n    const __m256 u2 = _mm256_mul_ps(u, u);\n    const __m256 num = _mm256_mul_ps(u, _mm256_add_ps(_mm256_set1_ps(27.0f), u2));\n    const __m256 den = _mm256_add_ps(_mm256_set1_ps(27.0f), _mm256_mul_ps(_mm256_set1_ps(9.0f), u2));\n    __m256 s = _mm256_div_ps(num, den);\n    s = _mm256_blendv_ps(s, _mm256_set1_ps(1.0f), _mm256_cmp_ps(u, _mm256_set1_ps(3.0f), _CMP_GT_OQ));\n    s = _mm256_blendv_ps(s, _mm256_set1_ps(-1.0f), _mm256_cmp_ps(u, _mm256_set1_ps(-3.0f), _CMP_LT_OQ));\n    return _mm256_add_ps(_mm256_mul_ps(x, dry), _mm256_mul_ps(_mm256_mul_ps(s, t), wet));\n}\n\nCEDAR_TARGET_AVX2\ninline void soft_avx2(const float* in_l, const float* in_r, const float* threshold,\n                      const float* dry_level, const float* wet_level,\n                      float* out_l, float* out_r) noexcept {\n    const __m256 lo = _mm256_set1_ps(0.1f);\n    const __m256 hi = _mm256_set1_ps(2.0f);\n    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < BLOCK_SIZE; i += 8) {\n        // std::clamp: (t < lo) ? lo : (hi < t) ? hi : t. max/min return the 2nd operand\n        // when either is NaN, so NaN passes through like the scalar (lo, hi are > 0).\n        const __m256 t = _mm256_min_ps(hi, _mm256_max_ps(lo, _mm256_load_ps(threshold + i)));\n        const __m256 dry = coeff8(dry_level, i, 0.0f);\n        const __m256 wet = coeff8(wet_level, i, 1.0f);\n        const __m256 xl = _mm256_load_ps(in_l + i);\n        const __m256 yl = soft8(xl, t, dry, wet);\n        _mm256_store_ps(out_l + i, yl);\n        if (in_r) {\n            _mm256_store_ps(out_r + i, soft8(_mm256_load_ps(in_r + i), t, dry, wet));\n        } else {\n            _mm256_store_ps(out_r + i, yl);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n#endif\n}  // namespace distort_kernels\n\n// ============================================================================\n// DISTORT_TANH: Tanh Saturation\n// ============================================================================\n// in0: input signal\n// in1: drive (1.0 = unity, higher = more saturation)\n//\n// Classic warm saturation using hyperbolic tangent.\n// Higher drive values push the signal into saturation more aggressively.\n\n[[gnu::always_inline]]\ninline void op_distort_tanh(ExecutionContext& ctx, const Instruction& inst) {\n    float* out_l = ctx.buffers->get(inst.out_buffer);\n    float* out_r = ctx.buffers->get(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(inst.out_buffer + 1));\n    const float* input = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[0]);\n    const bool stereo_in = (inst.flags & InstructionFlag::STEREO_INPUT) != 0;\n    const float* input_r = stereo_in\n        ? ctx.buffers->get(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(inst.inputs[0] + 1))\n        : nullptr;\n    const float* drive = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[1]);\n    const float* dry_level = (inst.inputs[2] != 0xFFFF) ? ctx.buffers->get(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(inst.inputs[0] + 1))\n        : nullptr;\n    const float* drive_in = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[1]);\n    const float* symmetry = (inst.inputs[2] != 0xFFFF) ? std::clamp(symmetry[i], 0.0f, 1.0f) : 0.5f;\n        float dry = drywet::coeff(dry_buf, i, dry_const);\n        float wet = drywet::coeff(wet_buf, i, wet_const);\n\n        for (std::size_t ch = 0; ch < 2; ++ch) {\n            float xin = (ch == 0) ? ctx.buffers->get(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(inst.inputs[0] + 1))\n        : nullptr;\n    const float* drive = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[1]);\n    const float* bias = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[2]);\n    const float* dry_level = (inst.inputs[3] != 0xFFFF) ? ctx.buffers->get(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(inst.inputs[0] + 1))\n        : nullptr;\n    const float* drive = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[1]);\n    const float* dry_level = (inst.inputs[2] != 0xFFFF) ? ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[2]) : nullptr;\n    const float* wet_level = (inst.inputs[3] != 0xFFFF) ? ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[3]) : nullptr;\n    auto& state = ctx.states->get_or_create<SmoothSatState>(inst.state_id);\n\n    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < BLOCK_SIZE; ++i) {\n        float d = std::clamp(drive[i], 1.0f, 20.0f);\n        float dry_m = drywet::coeff(dry_level, i, 0.0f);\n        float wet_m = drywet::coeff(wet_level, i, 1.0f);\n\n        for (std::size_t ch = 0; ch < 2; ++ch) {\n            float xin = (ch == 0) ? ctx.buffers->get(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(inst.inputs[0] + 1))\n        : nullptr;\n    const float* drive = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[1]);\n    const float* warmth = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[2]);\n    const float* soft_threshold_in = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[3]);\n    const float* warmth_scale_in = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[4]);\n    auto& state = ctx.states->get_or_create<TapeState>(inst.state_id);\n\n    // ExtendedParams<2>: ext[0] = dry (default 0.0), ext[1] = wet (default 1.0)\n    const auto* ext = ctx.states->get_if<ExtendedParams<2>>(ext_params_state_id(inst.state_id));\n    const float* dry_buf = nullptr; float dry_const = 0.0f;\n    const float* wet_buf = nullptr; float wet_const = 1.0f;\n    if (ext) {\n        const auto& ed = ext->params[0];\n        if (ed.is_constant()) dry_const = ed.constant; else dry_buf = ctx.buffers->get(ed.buffer_idx);\n        const auto& ew = ext->params[1];\n        if (ew.is_constant()) wet_const = ew.constant; else wet_buf = ctx.buffers->get(ew.buffer_idx);\n    }\n\n    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < BLOCK_SIZE; ++i) {\n        float d = std::clamp(drive[i], 1.0f, 10.0f);\n        float w = std::clamp(warmth[i], 0.0f, 1.0f);\n        float soft_threshold = soft_threshold_in[i] > 0.0f ? _mm256_load_ps(buf + i) : _mm256_set1_ps(fallback);\n}\n\n// simd: approx -- replaces std::tanh(z). Takes w = 2z*log2(e); tanh(z) = 1 - 2 / (e + 1),\n// e = 2^w, w clamped to [-28, 28] so e stays finite (tanh(9.7) == 1 to 4e-9).\n// 2^w = 2^n * poly4(f), f = w - n in [-1/2, 1/2] (no ln2 multiply); relative error ~5e-6\n// (tanh err ~2.5e-6).\nCEDAR_TARGET_AVX2 [[gnu::always_inline]]\ninline __m256 tanh8_exp(__m256 w) noexcept {\n    w = _mm256_min_ps(_mm256_set1_ps(28.0f), w);  // NaN in w propagates (2nd operand)\n    w = _mm256_max_ps(_mm256_set1_ps(-28.0f), w);\n    const __m256i n = _mm256_cvtps_epi32(w);\n    const __m256 r = _mm256_sub_ps(w, _mm256_cvtepi32_ps(n));\n    // 2^f = sum (ln2 f)^k / k!, degree-5 term Chebyshev-economised onto f, f^3 (a = 1/2):\n    // f^5 ~ 1.25 a^2 f^3 - 0.3125 a^4 f; omitted f^6 term is ~2.4e-6.\n    __m256 p = _mm256_set1_ps(0.0096181291f);\n    p = _mm256_add_ps(_mm256_mul_ps(p, r), _mm256_set1_ps(0.055920783f));\n    p = _mm256_add_ps(_mm256_mul_ps(p, r), _mm256_set1_ps(0.240226507f));\n    p = _mm256_add_ps(_mm256_mul_ps(p, r), _mm256_set1_ps(0.6931211385f));\n    p = _mm256_add_ps(_mm256_mul_ps(p, r), _mm256_set1_ps(1.0f));\n    // p in [0.7, 1.42] is normal: adding n to its exponent field scales by 2^n.\n    const __m256 e = _mm256_castsi256_ps(\n        _mm256_add_epi32(_mm256_castps_si256(p), _mm256_slli_epi32(n, 23)));\n    return _mm256_sub_ps(_mm256_set1_ps(1.0f),\n                         _mm256_div_ps(_mm256_set1_ps(2.0f), _mm256_add_ps(e, _mm256_set1_ps(1.0f))));\n}\n\n// All |z| < 0.0097: tanh(z) = z - z^3/3, error < 4e-7, so return z = w/(2 log2 e) and\n// skip the exp polynomial and divide (silent/quiet blocks). i < BLOCK_SIZE; i += 8) {\n        const __m256 d = _mm256_max_ps(_mm256_load_ps(drive + i), dmin);  // == (0.1f < d) ? d : 0.1f\n        const __m256 d2 = _mm256_mul_ps(d, k);  // tanh8 takes w = x*d*2*log2(e)\n        const __m256 dry = coeff8(dry_level, i, 0.0f);\n        const __m256 wet = coeff8(wet_level, i, 1.0f);\n        const __m256 xl = _mm256_load_ps(in_l + i);\n        const __m256 yl = _mm256_add_ps(_mm256_mul_ps(xl, dry),\n                                        _mm256_mul_ps(tanh8(_mm256_mul_ps(xl, d2)), wet));\n        _mm256_store_ps(out_l + i, yl);\n        if (in_r) {\n            const __m256 xr = _mm256_load_ps(in_r + i);\n            _mm256_store_ps(out_r + i, _mm256_add_ps(_mm256_mul_ps(xr, dry),\n                                        _mm256_mul_ps(tanh8(_mm256_mul_ps(xr, d2)), wet)));\n        } else {\n            _mm256_store_ps(out_r + i, yl);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Bit-identical to the scalar soft(x / t) * t mix.\nCEDAR_TARGET_AVX2 [[gnu::always_inline]]\ninline __m256 soft8(__m256 x, __m256 t, __m256 dry, __m256 wet) noexcept {\n    // Divide-free path (vdivps throughput bounds this kernel) when every lane is\n    // exactly zero (soft(+-0) = +-0, so s = x keeps the sign) or surely saturated\n    // (|x| > 3.001 t  =>  |x/t| > 3 despite rounding, s = +-1). Otherwise exact path.\n    const __m256 sign = _mm256_set1_ps(-0.0f);\n    const __m256 ax = _mm256_andnot_ps(sign, x);\n    const __m256 sat = _mm256_cmp_ps(ax, _mm256_mul_ps(t, _mm256_set1_ps(3.001f)), _CMP_GT_OQ);\n    const __m256 zero = _mm256_cmp_ps(x, _mm256_setzero_ps(), _CMP_EQ_OQ);\n    if (_mm256_movemask_ps(_mm256_or_ps(sat, zero)) == 0xFF) {\n        const __m256 one = _mm256_or_ps(_mm256_and_ps(x, sign), _mm256_set1_ps(1.0f));\n        const __m256 s = _mm256_blendv_ps(one, x, zero);\n        return _mm256_add_ps(_mm256_mul_ps(x, dry), _mm256_mul_ps(_mm256_mul_ps(s, t), wet));\n    }\n    const __m256 u = _mm256_div_ps(x, t);\n    const __m256 u2 = _mm256_mul_ps(u, u);\n    const __m256 num = _mm256_mul_ps(u, _mm256_add_ps(_mm256_set1_ps(27.0f), u2));\n    const __m256 den = _mm256_add_ps(_mm256_set1_ps(27.0f), _mm256_mul_ps(_mm256_set1_ps(9.0f), u2));\n    __m256 s = _mm256_div_ps(num, den);\n    s = _mm256_blendv_ps(s, _mm256_set1_ps(1.0f), _mm256_cmp_ps(u, _mm256_set1_ps(3.0f), _CMP_GT_OQ));\n    s = _mm256_blendv_ps(s, _mm256_set1_ps(-1.0f), _mm256_cmp_ps(u, _mm256_set1_ps(-3.0f), _CMP_LT_OQ));\n    return _mm256_add_ps(_mm256_mul_ps(x, dry), _mm256_mul_ps(_mm256_mul_ps(s, t), wet));\n}\n\nCEDAR_TARGET_AVX2\ninline void soft_avx2(const float* in_l, const float* in_r, const float* threshold,\n                      const float* dry_level, const float* wet_level,\n                      float* out_l, float* out_r) noexcept {\n    const __m256 lo = _mm256_set1_ps(0.1f);\n    const __m256 hi = _mm256_set1_ps(2.0f);\n    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < BLOCK_SIZE; i += 8) {\n        // std::clamp: (t < lo) ? lo : (hi < t) ? hi : t. max/min return the 2nd operand\n        // when either is NaN, so NaN passes through like the scalar (lo, hi are > 0).\n        const __m256 t = _mm256_min_ps(hi, _mm256_max_ps(lo, _mm256_load_ps(threshold + i)));\n        const __m256 dry = coeff8(dry_level, i, 0.0f);\n        const __m256 wet = coeff8(wet_level, i, 1.0f);\n        const __m256 xl = _mm256_load_ps(in_l + i);\n        const __m256 yl = soft8(xl, t, dry, wet);\n        _mm256_store_ps(out_l + i, yl);\n        if (in_r) {\n            _mm256_store_ps(out_r + i, soft8(_mm256_load_ps(in_r + i), t, dry, wet));\n        } else {\n            _mm256_store_ps(out_r + i, yl);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n#endif\n}  // namespace distort_kernels\n\n// ============================================================================\n// DISTORT_TANH: Tanh Saturation\n// ============================================================================\n// in0: input signal\n// in1: drive (1.0 = unity, higher = more saturation)\n//\n// Classic warm saturation using hyperbolic tangent.\n// Higher drive values push the signal into saturation more aggressively.\n\n[[gnu::always_inline]]\ninline void op_distort_tanh(ExecutionContext& ctx, const Instruction& inst) {\n    float* out_l = ctx.buffers->get(inst.out_buffer);\n    float* out_r = ctx.buffers->get(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(inst.out_buffer + 1));\n    const float* input = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[0]);\n    const bool stereo_in = (inst.flags & InstructionFlag::STEREO_INPUT) != 0;\n    const float* input_r = stereo_in\n        ? ctx.buffers->get(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(inst.inputs[0] + 1))\n        : nullptr;\n    const float* drive = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[1]);\n    const float* dry_level = (inst.inputs[2] != 0xFFFF) ? ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[2]) : nullptr;\n    const float* wet_level = (inst.inputs[3] != 0xFFFF) ? ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[3]) : nullptr;\n\n#if CEDAR_SIMD_X86\n    if (simd::has(simd::Isa::Avx2)) {\n        distort_kernels::tanh_avx2(input, input_r, drive, dry_level, wet_level, out_l, out_r);\n        return;\n    }\n#endif\n    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < BLOCK_SIZE; ++i) {\n        float d = std::max(0.1f, drive[i]);\n        float dry = drywet::coeff(dry_level, i, 0.0f);\n        float wet = drywet::coeff(wet_level, i, 1.0f);\n        float x_l = input[i];\n        float x_r = stereo_in ? ctx.buffers->get(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(inst.inputs[0] + 1))\n        : nullptr;\n    const float* threshold = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[1]);\n    const float* dry_level = (inst.inputs[2] != 0xFFFF) ? ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[2]) : nullptr;\n    const float* wet_level = (inst.inputs[3] != 0xFFFF) ? ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[3]) : nullptr;\n\n    auto soft = [](float x) {\n        if (x > 3.0f) return 1.0f;\n        if (x < -3.0f) return -1.0f;\n        float x2 = x * x;\n        return x * (27.0f + x2) / (27.0f + 9.0f * x2);\n    };\n\n#if CEDAR_SIMD_X86\n    if (simd::has(simd::Isa::Avx2)) {\n        distort_kernels::soft_avx2(input, input_r, threshold, dry_level, wet_level, out_l, out_r);\n        return;\n    }\n#endif\n    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < BLOCK_SIZE; ++i) {\n        float t = std::clamp(threshold[i], 0.1f, 2.0f);\n        float dry = drywet::coeff(dry_level, i, 0.0f);\n        float wet = drywet::coeff(wet_level, i, 1.0f);\n        float x_l = input[i];\n        float x_r = stereo_in ? input_r[i] : x_l;\n        out_l[i] = drywet::mix(x_l, soft(x_l / t) * t, dry, wet);\n        out_r[i] = drywet::mix(x_r, soft(x_r / t) * t, dry, wet);\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// DISTORT_BITCRUSH: Bit Crusher / Sample Rate Reducer\n// ============================================================================\n// in0: input signal\n// in1: bit depth (1-16, fractional allowed for smooth transitions)\n// in2: sample rate reduction factor (0.0-1.0, where 1.0 = full rate, 0.1 = 1/10th rate)\n//\n// Lo-fi effect that reduces bit depth and/or sample rate.\n// Creates classic 8-bit and retro digital sounds.\n\n[[gnu::always_inline]]\ninline void op_distort_bitcrush(ExecutionContext& ctx, const Instruction& inst) {\n    float* out_l = ctx.buffers->get(inst.out_buffer);\n    float* out_r = ctx.buffers->get(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(inst.out_buffer + 1));\n    const float* input = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[0]);\n    const bool stereo_in = (inst.flags & InstructionFlag::STEREO_INPUT) != 0;\n    const float* input_r = stereo_in\n        ? ctx.buffers->get(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(inst.inputs[0] + 1))\n        : nullptr;\n    const float* bits = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[1]);\n    const float* rate = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[2]);\n    const float* dry_level = (inst.inputs[3] != 0xFFFF) ? ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[3]) : nullptr;\n    const float* wet_level = (inst.inputs[4] != 0xFFFF) ? ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[4]) : nullptr;\n    auto& state = ctx.states->get_or_create<BitcrushState>(inst.state_id);\n\n    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < BLOCK_SIZE; ++i) {\n        // Mono control inputs (shared across channels)\n        float rate_factor = std::clamp(rate[i], 0.01f, 1.0f);\n        float depth = std::clamp(bits[i], 1.0f, 16.0f);\n        float levels = std::pow(2.0f, depth);\n        float dry = drywet::coeff(dry_level, i, 0.0f);\n        float wet = drywet::coeff(wet_level, i, 1.0f);\n\n        for (std::size_t ch = 0; ch < 2; ++ch) {\n            float x = (ch == 0) ? input[i] : (stereo_in ? input_r[i] : input[i]);\n            state.phase[ch] += rate_factor;\n            if (state.phase[ch] >= 1.0f) {\n                state.phase[ch] -= 1.0f;\n                state.held_sample[ch] = std::round(x * levels) / levels;\n            }\n            (ch == 0 ? out_l : out_r)[i] = drywet::mix(x, state.held_sample[ch], dry, wet);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// DISTORT_FOLD: Wavefolder with ADAA (Antiderivative Antialiasing)\n// ============================================================================\n// in0: input signal\n// in1: drive (1.0-10.0, fold intensity)\n// in2: symmetry (0.0-1.0, 0.5 = symmetric, other = asymmetric harmonics)\n//\n// Alias-free sine wavefolder using first-order ADAA.\n// Classic West Coast synthesis technique with mathematical anti-aliasing.\n// f(x) = sin(drive * x)\n// F₁(x) = -cos(drive * x) / drive  (antiderivative)\n// ADAA: y[n] = (F₁(x[n]) - F₁(x[n-1])) / (x[n] - x[n-1])\n\n[[gnu::always_inline]]\ninline void op_distort_fold(ExecutionContext& ctx, const Instruction& inst) {\n    float* out_l = ctx.buffers->get(inst.out_buffer);\n    float* out_r = ctx.buffers->get(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(inst.out_buffer + 1));\n    const float* input = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[0]);\n    const bool stereo_in = (inst.flags & InstructionFlag::STEREO_INPUT) != 0;\n    const float* input_r = stereo_in\n        ? ctx.buffers->get(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(inst.inputs[0] + 1))\n        : nullptr;\n    const float* drive_in = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[1]);\n    const float* symmetry = (inst.inputs[2] != 0xFFFF) ? ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[2]) : nullptr;\n    auto& state = ctx.states->get_or_create<FoldADAAState>(inst.state_id);\n\n    // ExtendedParams<2>: ext[0] = dry (default 0.0), ext[1] = wet (default 1.0)\n    const auto* ext = ctx.states->get_if<ExtendedParams<2>>(ext_params_state_id(inst.state_id));\n    const float* dry_buf = nullptr; float dry_const = 0.0f;\n    const float* wet_buf = nullptr; float wet_const = 1.0f;\n    if (ext) {\n        const auto& d = ext->params[0];\n        if (d.is_constant()) dry_const = d.constant; else dry_buf = ctx.buffers->get(d.buffer_idx);\n        const auto& w = ext->params[1];\n        if (w.is_constant()) wet_const = w.constant; else wet_buf = ctx.buffers->get(w.buffer_idx);\n    }\n\n    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < BLOCK_SIZE; ++i) {\n        // Mono control inputs (shared across channels)\n        float drive = std::clamp(drive_in[i], 1.0f, 10.0f);\n        float sym = symmetry ? std::clamp(symmetry[i], 0.0f, 1.0f) : 0.5f;\n        float dry = drywet::coeff(dry_buf, i, dry_const);\n        float wet = drywet::coeff(wet_buf, i, wet_const);\n\n        for (std::size_t ch = 0; ch < 2; ++ch) {\n            float xin = (ch == 0) ? input[i] : (stereo_in ? input_r[i] : input[i]);\n            float x = xin + (sym - 0.5f) * 0.5f;\n            float x_scaled = x * drive;\n            float ad = -std::cos(x_scaled) / drive;\n\n            float diff = x_scaled - state.x_prev[ch];\n            float y;\n            if (std::abs(diff) < 1e-5f) {\n                float mid = (x_scaled + state.x_prev[ch]) * 0.5f;\n                y = std::sin(mid);\n            } else {\n                y = (ad - state.ad_prev[ch]) / (diff / drive);\n            }\n\n            state.x_prev[ch] = x_scaled;\n            state.ad_prev[ch] = ad;\n            float processed = std::clamp(y, -1.0f, 1.0f);\n            (ch == 0 ? out_l : out_r)[i] = drywet::mix(xin, processed, dry, wet);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// DISTORT_TUBE: Asymmetric Tube-Style Saturation\n// ============================================================================\n// in0: input signal\n// in1: drive (1-20, higher = more saturation)\n// in2: bias (0.0-0.3, controls even harmonic content)\n//\n// Emulates triode tube saturation with asymmetric transfer function.\n// Produces even harmonics (especially 2nd) for warm, vintage character.\n// Uses 2x oversampling by default to reduce aliasing.\n\n[[gnu::always_inline]]\ninline void op_distort_tube(ExecutionContext& ctx, const Instruction& inst) {\n    float* out_l = ctx.buffers->get(inst.out_buffer);\n    float* out_r = ctx.buffers->get(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(inst.out_buffer + 1));\n    const float* input = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[0]);\n    const bool stereo_in = (inst.flags & InstructionFlag::STEREO_INPUT) != 0;\n    const float* input_r = stereo_in\n        ? ctx.buffers->get(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(inst.inputs[0] + 1))\n        : nullptr;\n    const float* drive = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[1]);\n    const float* bias = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[2]);\n    const float* dry_level = (inst.inputs[3] != 0xFFFF) ? ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[3]) : nullptr;\n    const float* wet_level = (inst.inputs[4] != 0xFFFF) ? ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[4]) : nullptr;\n    auto& state = ctx.states->get_or_create<TubeState>(inst.state_id);\n\n    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < BLOCK_SIZE; ++i) {\n        float d = std::clamp(drive[i], 1.0f, 20.0f);\n        float b = std::clamp(bias[i], 0.0f, 0.3f);\n        float dry_m = drywet::coeff(dry_level, i, 0.0f);\n        float wet_m = drywet::coeff(wet_level, i, 1.0f);\n\n        auto tube_core = [d, b](float s) {\n            float driven = s * d + b;\n            float y;\n            if (driven >= 0.0f) {\n                y = 1.0f - std::exp(-driven);\n            } else {\n                y = std::tanh(driven * 1.2f);\n            }\n            return std::clamp(y, -1.0f, 1.0f);\n        };\n\n        for (std::size_t ch = 0; ch < 2; ++ch) {\n            float x = (ch == 0) ? input[i] : (stereo_in ? input_r[i] : input[i]);\n\n            // 2x oversampling using per-channel delay line\n            state.os_delay[ch][state.os_idx[ch]] = x;\n            float x0 = x;\n            float x1 = (x + state.os_delay[ch][(state.os_idx[ch] + 3) & 3]) * 0.5f;\n\n            float y0 = tube_core(x0);\n            float y1 = tube_core(x1);\n            (ch == 0 ? out_l : out_r)[i] = drywet::mix(x, (y0 + y1) * 0.5f, dry_m, wet_m);\n            state.os_idx[ch] = (state.os_idx[ch] + 1) & 3;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// DISTORT_SMOOTH: ADAA (Antiderivative Antialiasing) Saturation\n// ============================================================================\n// in0: input signal\n// in1: drive (1-20, higher = more saturation)\n//\n// Alias-free tanh saturation using first-order antiderivative antialiasing.\n// Produces clean, high-quality saturation without harsh aliasing artifacts.\n// No oversampling needed - ADAA handles antialiasing mathematically.\n\n[[gnu::always_inline]]\ninline void op_distort_smooth(ExecutionContext& ctx, const Instruction& inst) {\n    float* out_l = ctx.buffers->get(inst.out_buffer);\n    float* out_r = ctx.buffers->get(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(inst.out_buffer + 1));\n    const float* input = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[0]);\n    const bool stereo_in = (inst.flags & InstructionFlag::STEREO_INPUT) != 0;\n    const float* input_r = stereo_in\n        ? ctx.buffers->get(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(inst.inputs[0] + 1))\n        : nullptr;\n    const float* drive = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[1]);\n    const float* dry_level = (inst.inputs[2] != 0xFFFF) ? ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[2]) : nullptr;\n    const float* wet_level = (inst.inputs[3] != 0xFFFF) ? ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[3]) : nullptr;\n    auto& state = ctx.states->get_or_create<SmoothSatState>(inst.state_id);\n\n    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < BLOCK_SIZE; ++i) {\n        float d = std::clamp(drive[i], 1.0f, 20.0f);\n        float dry_m = drywet::coeff(dry_level, i, 0.0f);\n        float wet_m = drywet::coeff(wet_level, i, 1.0f);\n\n        for (std::size_t ch = 0; ch < 2; ++ch) {\n            float xin = (ch == 0) ? input[i] : (stereo_in ? input_r[i] : input[i]);\n            float x = xin * d;\n\n            float abs_x = std::abs(x);\n            float ad = abs_x + std::log1p(std::exp(-2.0f * abs_x)) - 0.693147f;\n\n            float y;\n            if (!state.initialized[ch]) {\n                y = std::tanh(x);\n                state.initialized[ch] = true;\n            } else {\n                float diff = x - state.x_prev[ch];\n                if (std::abs(diff) < 1e-4f) {\n                    y = std::tanh((x + state.x_prev[ch]) * 0.5f);\n                } else {\n                    float ad_diff;\n                    float abs_xp = std::abs(state.x_prev[ch]);\n                    if (abs_x > 0.5f && abs_xp > 0.5f && (x > 0) == (state.x_prev[ch] > 0)) {\n                        float abs_diff = (x > 0) ? diff : -diff;\n                        float log_diff = std::log1p(std::exp(-2.0f * abs_x))\n                                       - std::log1p(std::exp(-2.0f * abs_xp));\n                        ad_diff = abs_diff + log_diff;\n                    } else {\n                        ad_diff = ad - state.ad_prev[ch];\n                    }\n                    y = ad_diff / diff;\n                }\n            }\n\n            state.x_prev[ch] = x;\n            state.ad_prev[ch] = ad;\n            (ch == 0 ? Takes w = 2z*log2(e); tanh(z) = 1 - 2 / (e + 1),\n// e = 2^w, w clamped to [-28, 28] so e stays finite (tanh(9.7) == 1 to 4e-9).\n// 2^w = 2^n * poly4(f), f = w - n in [-1/2, 1/2] (no ln2 multiply); relative error ~5e-6\n// (tanh err ~2.5e-6).\nCEDAR_TARGET_AVX2 [[gnu::always_inline]]\ninline __m256 tanh8_exp(__m256 w) noexcept {\n    w = _mm256_min_ps(_mm256_set1_ps(28.0f), w);  // NaN in w propagates (2nd operand)\n    w = _mm256_max_ps(_mm256_set1_ps(-28.0f), w);\n    const __m256i n = _mm256_cvtps_epi32(w);\n    const __m256 r = _mm256_sub_ps(w, _mm256_cvtepi32_ps(n));\n    // 2^f = sum (ln2 f)^k / k!, degree-5 term Chebyshev-economised onto f, f^3 (a = 1/2):\n    // f^5 ~ 1.25 a^2 f^3 - 0.3125 a^4 f; omitted f^6 term is ~2.4e-6.\n    __m256 p = _mm256_set1_ps(0.0096181291f);\n    p = _mm256_add_ps(_mm256_mul_ps(p, r), _mm256_set1_ps(0.055920783f));\n    p = _mm256_add_ps(_mm256_mul_ps(p, r), _mm256_set1_ps(0.240226507f));\n    p = _mm256_add_ps(_mm256_mul_ps(p, r), _mm256_set1_ps(0.6931211385f));\n    p = _mm256_add_ps(_mm256_mul_ps(p, r), _mm256_set1_ps(1.0f));\n    // p in [0.7, 1.42] is normal: adding n to its exponent field scales by 2^n.\n    const __m256 e = _mm256_castsi256_ps(\n        _mm256_add_epi32(_mm256_castps_si256(p), _mm256_slli_epi32(n, 23)));\n    return _mm256_sub_ps(_mm256_set1_ps(1.0f),\n                         _mm256_div_ps(_mm256_set1_ps(2.0f), _mm256_add_ps(e, _mm256_set1_ps(1.0f))));\n}\n\n// All |z| < 0.0097: tanh(z) = z - z^3/3, error < 4e-7, so return z = w/(2 log2 e) and\n// skip the exp polynomial and divide (silent/quiet blocks). NaN -> slow path.\nCEDAR_TARGET_AVX2 [[gnu::always_inline]]\ninline __m256 tanh8(__m256 w) noexcept {\n    if (_mm256_movemask_ps(_mm256_cmp_ps(_mm256_andnot_ps(_mm256_set1_ps(-0.0f), w),\n                                         _mm256_set1_ps(0.028f), _CMP_LT_OQ)) == 0xFF)\n        return _mm256_mul_ps(w, _mm256_set1_ps(0.34657359f));\n    return tanh8_exp(w);\n}\n\n// Two vectors under one quiet-block check (fewer uops per vector on loud signals).\nCEDAR_TARGET_AVX2 [[gnu::always_inline]]\ninline void tanh8x2(__m256 w0, __m256 w1, __m256& y0, __m256& y1) noexcept {\n    const __m256 sign = _mm256_set1_ps(-0.0f);\n    // |w0| + |w1| < 0.056 implies both < 0.056 (tanh err <= 2.4e-6 via z - z^3/3); a NaN in\n    // either makes the sum NaN, and the ordered compare is false, so NaN -> slow path.\n    const __m256 s = _mm256_add_ps(_mm256_andnot_ps(sign, w0), _mm256_andnot_ps(sign, w1));\n    if (_mm256_movemask_ps(_mm256_cmp_ps(s, _mm256_set1_ps(0.056f), _CMP_LT_OQ)) == 0xFF) {\n        const __m256 c = _mm256_set1_ps(0.34657359f);\n        y0 = _mm256_mul_ps(w0, c);\n        y1 = _mm256_mul_ps(w1, c);\n        return;\n    }\n    y0 = tanh8_exp(w0);\n    y1 = tanh8_exp(w1);\n}\n\nCEDAR_TARGET_AVX2\ninline void tanh_avx2(const float* in_l, const float* in_r, const float* drive,\n                      const float* dry_level, const float* wet_level,\n                      float* out_l, float* out_r) noexcept {\n    const __m256 dmin = _mm256_set1_ps(0.1f);\n    const __m256 k = _mm256_set1_ps(2.88539008f);  // 2 * log2(e)\n    if (!dry_level && !wet_level) {\n        // Default dry=0, wet=1: x*0 + y*1 == y for finite x, so skip the mix.\n        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < BLOCK_SIZE; i += 16) {\n            const __m256 da = _mm256_mul_ps(_mm256_max_ps(_mm256_load_ps(drive + i), dmin), k);\n            const __m256 db = _mm256_mul_ps(_mm256_max_ps(_mm256_load_ps(drive + i + 8), dmin), k);\n            __m256 la, lb;\n            tanh8x2(_mm256_mul_ps(_mm256_load_ps(in_l + i), da),\n                    _mm256_mul_ps(_mm256_load_ps(in_l + i + 8), db), la, lb);\n            _mm256_store_ps(out_l + i, la);\n            _mm256_store_ps(out_l + i + 8, lb);\n            if (in_r) {\n                __m256 ra, rb;\n                tanh8x2(_mm256_mul_ps(_mm256_load_ps(in_r + i), da),\n                        _mm256_mul_ps(_mm256_load_ps(in_r + i + 8), db), ra, rb);\n                _mm256_store_ps(out_r + i, ra);\n                _mm256_store_ps(out_r + i + 8, rb);\n            } else {\n                _mm256_store_ps(out_r + i, la);\n                _mm256_store_ps(out_r + i + 8, lb);\n            }\n        }\n        return;\n    }\n    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < BLOCK_SIZE; i += 8) {\n        const __m256 d = _mm256_max_ps(_mm256_load_ps(drive + i), dmin);  // == (0.1f < d) ? d : 0.1f\n        const __m256 d2 = _mm256_mul_ps(d, k);  // tanh8 takes w = x*d*2*log2(e)\n        const __m256 dry = coeff8(dry_level, i, 0.0f);\n        const __m256 wet = coeff8(wet_level, i, 1.0f);\n        const __m256 xl = _mm256_load_ps(in_l + i);\n        const __m256 yl = _mm256_add_ps(_mm256_mul_ps(xl, dry),\n                                        _mm256_mul_ps(tanh8(_mm256_mul_ps(xl, d2)), wet));\n        _mm256_store_ps(out_l + i, yl);\n        if (in_r) {\n            const __m256 xr = _mm256_load_ps(in_r + i);\n            _mm256_store_ps(out_r + i, _mm256_add_ps(_mm256_mul_ps(xr, dry),\n                                        _mm256_mul_ps(tanh8(_mm256_mul_ps(xr, d2)), wet)));\n        } else {\n            _mm256_store_ps(out_r + i, yl);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Bit-identical to the scalar soft(x / t) * t mix.\nCEDAR_TARGET_AVX2 [[gnu::always_inline]]\ninline __m256 soft8(__m256 x, __m256 t, __m256 dry, __m256 wet) noexcept {\n    // Divide-free path (vdivps throughput bounds this kernel) when every lane is\n    // exactly zero (soft(+-0) = +-0, so s = x keeps the sign) or surely saturated\n    // (|x| > 3.001 t  =>  |x/t| > 3 despite rounding, s = +-1). Otherwise exact path.\n    const __m256 sign = _mm256_set1_ps(-0.0f);\n    const __m256 ax = _mm256_andnot_ps(sign, x);\n    const __m256 sat = _mm256_cmp_ps(ax, _mm256_mul_ps(t, _mm256_set1_ps(3.001f)), _CMP_GT_OQ);\n    const __m256 zero = _mm256_cmp_ps(x, _mm256_setzero_ps(), _CMP_EQ_OQ);\n    if (_mm256_movemask_ps(_mm256_or_ps(sat, zero)) == 0xFF) {\n        const __m256 one = _mm256_or_ps(_mm256_and_ps(x, sign), _mm256_set1_ps(1.0f));\n        const __m256 s = _mm256_blendv_ps(one, x, zero);\n        return _mm256_add_ps(_mm256_mul_ps(x, dry), _mm256_mul_ps(_mm256_mul_ps(s, t), wet));\n    }\n    const __m256 u = _mm256_div_ps(x, t);\n    const __m256 u2 = _mm256_mul_ps(u, u);\n    const __m256 num = _mm256_mul_ps(u, _mm256_add_ps(_mm256_set1_ps(27.0f), u2));\n    const __m256 den = _mm256_add_ps(_mm256_set1_ps(27.0f), _mm256_mul_ps(_mm256_set1_ps(9.0f), u2));\n    __m256 s = _mm256_div_ps(num, den);\n    s = _mm256_blendv_ps(s, _mm256_set1_ps(1.0f), _mm256_cmp_ps(u, _mm256_set1_ps(3.0f), _CMP_GT_OQ));\n    s = _mm256_blendv_ps(s, _mm256_set1_ps(-1.0f), _mm256_cmp_ps(u, _mm256_set1_ps(-3.0f), _CMP_LT_OQ));\n    return _mm256_add_ps(_mm256_mul_ps(x, dry), _mm256_mul_ps(_mm256_mul_ps(s, t), wet));\n}\n\nCEDAR_TARGET_AVX2\ninline void soft_avx2(const float* in_l, const float* in_r, const float* threshold,\n                      const float* dry_level, const float* wet_level,\n                      float* out_l, float* out_r) noexcept {\n    const __m256 lo = _mm256_set1_ps(0.1f);\n    const __m256 hi = _mm256_set1_ps(2.0f);\n    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < BLOCK_SIZE; i += 8) {\n        // std::clamp: (t < lo) ? lo : (hi < t) ? hi : t. max/min return the 2nd operand\n        // when either is NaN, so NaN passes through like the scalar (lo, hi are > 0).\n        const __m256 t = _mm256_min_ps(hi, _mm256_max_ps(lo, _mm256_load_ps(threshold + i)));\n        const __m256 dry = coeff8(dry_level, i, 0.0f);\n        const __m256 wet = coeff8(wet_level, i, 1.0f);\n        const __m256 xl = _mm256_load_ps(in_l + i);\n        const __m256 yl = soft8(xl, t, dry, wet);\n        _mm256_store_ps(out_l + i, yl);\n        if (in_r) {\n            _mm256_store_ps(out_r + i, soft8(_mm256_load_ps(in_r + i), t, dry, wet));\n        } else {\n            _mm256_store_ps(out_r + i, yl);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n#endif\n}  // namespace distort_kernels\n\n// ============================================================================\n// DISTORT_TANH: Tanh Saturation\n// ============================================================================\n// in0: input signal\n// in1: drive (1.0 = unity, higher = more saturation)\n//\n// Classic warm saturation using hyperbolic tangent.\n// Higher drive values push the signal into saturation more aggressively.\n\n[[gnu::always_inline]]\ninline void op_distort_tanh(ExecutionContext& ctx, const Instruction& inst) {\n    float* out_l = ctx.buffers->get(inst.out_buffer);\n    float* out_r = ctx.buffers->get(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(inst.out_buffer + 1));\n    const float* input = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[0]);\n    const bool stereo_in = (inst.flags & InstructionFlag::STEREO_INPUT) != 0;\n    const float* input_r = stereo_in\n        ? ctx.buffers->get(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(inst.inputs[0] + 1))\n        : nullptr;\n    const float* drive = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[1]);\n    const float* dry_level = (inst.inputs[2] != 0xFFFF) ? ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[2]) : nullptr;\n    const float* wet_level = (inst.inputs[3] != 0xFFFF) ? ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[3]) : nullptr;\n\n#if CEDAR_SIMD_X86\n    if (simd::has(simd::Isa::Avx2)) {\n        distort_kernels::tanh_avx2(input, input_r, drive, dry_level, wet_level, out_l, out_r);\n        return;\n    }\n#endif\n    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < BLOCK_SIZE; ++i) {\n        float d = std::max(0.1f, drive[i]);\n        float dry = drywet::coeff(dry_level, i, 0.0f);\n        float wet = drywet::coeff(wet_level, i, 1.0f);\n        float x_l = input[i];\n        float x_r = stereo_in ? input_r[i] : x_l;\n        out_l[i] = drywet::mix(x_l, std::tanh(x_l * d), dry, wet);\n        out_r[i] = drywet::mix(x_r, std::tanh(x_r * d), dry, wet);\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// DISTORT_SOFT: Polynomial Soft Clipping\n// ============================================================================\n// in0: input signal\n// in1: threshold (0.1-2.0, lower = more clipping)\n//\n// Smooth polynomial soft clipper that rounds off peaks gradually.\n// Uses cubic polynomial for continuous first derivative.\n\n[[gnu::always_inline]]\ninline void op_distort_soft(ExecutionContext& ctx, const Instruction& inst) {\n    float* out_l = ctx.buffers->get(inst.out_buffer);\n    float* out_r = ctx.buffers->get(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(inst.out_buffer + 1));\n    const float* input = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[0]);\n    const bool stereo_in = (inst.flags & InstructionFlag::STEREO_INPUT) != 0;\n    const float* input_r = stereo_in\n        ? ctx.buffers->get(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(inst.inputs[0] + 1))\n        : nullptr;\n    const float* threshold = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[1]);\n    const float* dry_level = (inst.inputs[2] != 0xFFFF) ? ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[2]) : nullptr;\n    const float* wet_level = (inst.inputs[3] != 0xFFFF) ? ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[3]) : nullptr;\n\n    auto soft = [](float x) {\n        if (x > 3.0f) return 1.0f;\n        if (x < -3.0f) return -1.0f;\n        float x2 = x * x;\n        return x * (27.0f + x2) / (27.0f + 9.0f * x2);\n    };\n\n#if CEDAR_SIMD_X86\n    if (simd::has(simd::Isa::Avx2)) {\n        distort_kernels::soft_avx2(input, input_r, threshold, dry_level, wet_level, out_l, out_r);\n        return;\n    }\n#endif\n    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < BLOCK_SIZE; ++i) {\n        float t = std::clamp(threshold[i], 0.1f, 2.0f);\n        float dry = drywet::coeff(dry_level, i, 0.0f);\n        float wet = drywet::coeff(wet_level, i, 1.0f);\n        float x_l = input[i];\n        float x_r = stereo_in ? input_r[i] : x_l;\n        out_l[i] = drywet::mix(x_l, soft(x_l / t) * t, dry, wet);\n        out_r[i] = drywet::mix(x_r, soft(x_r / t) * t, dry, wet);\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// DISTORT_BITCRUSH: Bit Crusher / Sample Rate Reducer\n// ============================================================================\n// in0: input signal\n// in1: bit depth (1-16, fractional allowed for smooth transitions)\n// in2: sample rate reduction factor (0.0-1.0, where 1.0 = full rate, 0.1 = 1/10th rate)\n//\n// Lo-fi effect that reduces bit depth and/or sample rate.\n// Creates classic 8-bit and retro digital sounds.\n\n[[gnu::always_inline]]\ninline void op_distort_bitcrush(ExecutionContext& ctx, const Instruction& inst) {\n    float* out_l = ctx.buffers->get(inst.out_buffer);\n    float* out_r = ctx.buffers->get(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(inst.out_buffer + 1));\n    const float* input = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[0]);\n    const bool stereo_in = (inst.flags & InstructionFlag::STEREO_INPUT) != 0;\n    const float* input_r = stereo_in\n        ? ctx.buffers->get(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(inst.inputs[0] + 1))\n        : nullptr;\n    const float* bits = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[1]);\n    const float* rate = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[2]);\n    const float* dry_level = (inst.inputs[3] != 0xFFFF) ? ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[3]) : nullptr;\n    const float* wet_level = (inst.inputs[4] != 0xFFFF) ? ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[4]) : nullptr;\n    auto& state = ctx.states->get_or_create<BitcrushState>(inst.state_id);\n\n    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < BLOCK_SIZE; ++i) {\n        // Mono control inputs (shared across channels)\n        float rate_factor = std::clamp(rate[i], 0.01f, 1.0f);\n        float depth = std::clamp(bits[i], 1.0f, 16.0f);\n        float levels = std::pow(2.0f, depth);\n        float dry = drywet::coeff(dry_level, i, 0.0f);\n        float wet = drywet::coeff(wet_level, i, 1.0f);\n\n        for (std::size_t ch = 0; ch < 2; ++ch) {\n            float x = (ch == 0) ? input[i] : (stereo_in ? input_r[i] : input[i]);\n            state.phase[ch] += rate_factor;\n            if (state.phase[ch] >= 1.0f) {\n                state.phase[ch] -= 1.0f;\n                state.held_sample[ch] = std::round(x * levels) / levels;\n            }\n            (ch == 0 ? out_l : out_r)[i] = drywet::mix(x, state.held_sample[ch], dry, wet);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// DISTORT_FOLD: Wavefolder with ADAA (Antiderivative Antialiasing)\n// ============================================================================\n// in0: input signal\n// in1: drive (1.0-10.0, fold intensity)\n// in2: symmetry (0.0-1.0, 0.5 = symmetric, other = asymmetric harmonics)\n//\n// Alias-free sine wavefolder using first-order ADAA.\n// Classic West Coast synthesis technique with mathematical anti-aliasing.\n// f(x) = sin(drive * x)\n// F₁(x) = -cos(drive * x) / drive  (antiderivative)\n// ADAA: y[n] = (F₁(x[n]) - F₁(x[n-1])) / (x[n] - x[n-1])\n\n[[gnu::always_inline]]\ninline void op_distort_fold(ExecutionContext& ctx, const Instruction& inst) {\n    float* out_l = ctx.buffers->get(inst.out_buffer);\n    float* out_r = ctx.buffers->get(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(inst.out_buffer + 1));\n    const float* input = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[0]);\n    const bool stereo_in = (inst.flags & InstructionFlag::STEREO_INPUT) != 0;\n    const float* input_r = stereo_in\n        ? ctx.buffers->get(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(inst.inputs[0] + 1))\n        : nullptr;\n    const float* drive_in = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[1]);\n    const float* symmetry = (inst.inputs[2] != 0xFFFF) ? ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[2]) : nullptr;\n    auto& state = ctx.states->get_or_create<FoldADAAState>(inst.state_id);\n\n    // ExtendedParams<2>: ext[0] = dry (default 0.0), ext[1] = wet (default 1.0)\n    const auto* ext = ctx.states->get_if<ExtendedParams<2>>(ext_params_state_id(inst.state_id));\n    const float* dry_buf = nullptr; float dry_const = 0.0f;\n    const float* wet_buf = nullptr; float wet_const = 1.0f;\n    if (ext) {\n        const auto& d = ext->params[0];\n        if (d.is_constant()) dry_const = d.constant; else dry_buf = ctx.buffers->get(d.buffer_idx);\n        const auto& w = ext->params[1];\n        if (w.is_constant()) wet_const = w.constant; else wet_buf = ctx.buffers->get(w.buffer_idx);\n    }\n\n    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < BLOCK_SIZE; ++i) {\n        // Mono control inputs (shared across channels)\n        float drive = std::clamp(drive_in[i], 1.0f, 10.0f);\n        float sym = symmetry ? std::clamp(symmetry[i], 0.0f, 1.0f) : 0.5f;\n        float dry = drywet::coeff(dry_buf, i, dry_const);\n        float wet = drywet::coeff(wet_buf, i, wet_const);\n\n        for (std::size_t ch = 0; ch < 2; ++ch) {\n            float xin = (ch == 0) ? {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5","id":"msg_011CfRygDVu6C2eSunoyXXsc","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"I've made two changes to `distortion.hpp`, and the check ran through bit-identity and the short benchmark. `op_distort_soft` is 1.17x faster (39.6 to 33.99 ns/block). `op_distort_tanh` moved from 41.49 to 40.84 ns/block (1.02x), which is within noise. I only saw the tail of the check output, so I didn't see the allowlist and bit-identity lines themselves. I didn't commit anything.\n\n- **`soft8`:** in the slow path I replaced the two compare-and-blend saturation steps with a min/max clamp of `u` to [-3, 3]. This is bit-exact because soft(±3) is exactly ±1 (108/108). NaN still propagates.\n- **`tanh_avx2`:** on the default path (no dry/wet levels), the quiet-block check now covers two vectors at once through a new `tanh8x2`, instead of one check per vector. It tests `|w0|+|w1| < 0.056`, which keeps the tanh error under about 2.4e-6, and a NaN in either vector sends both to the exp path. The 0.056 threshold is my own error bound, worked out by hand.\n\nThe `tanh` change did not clear the 5 % bar on its own, so the attempt rests on `soft`.\n\nIDEA: vector uop count in `soft8` (and quiet-check overhead in `tanh8`) -> replaced the two cmp+blendv saturation steps with a min/max clamp of u to [-3,3] (soft(±3) is exactly ±1, bit-identical) and shared one quiet-block check across two tanh vectors via |w0|+|w1| < 0.056 (short bench: distort_soft 1.17x, distort_tanh 1.02x, within noise)"}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1947,"cache_read_input_tokens":37994,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1947},"output_tokens":8,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"1e1b1787-c8ec-47c1-b72a-a8a0a8a99cd4","uuid":"599f0ffb-a2a4-4d86-89c5-8513476c005e","timestamp":"2026-09-26T11:33:01.148Z","request_id":"req_011CfRygD6MQEcKAP2rW6bcX"}
